name: model
description: The honesty suite's model-backed subset (the solvi-decide checkpoint): run before publishing a decider. gold: the right answer; "other" when no team fits (the decider's threshold), null where a person should decide (two teams at once). Only the numbers are gated; single answers are not pinned, a model may move them.
